The Cisco NCS 540 N540‑24Z8Q2C‑M is a compact, high-performance, carrier-grade 1RU router designed for next-generation metro aggregation and edge networks. Equipped with 24×10G SFP+, 8×25G SFP28, and 2×100G QSFP28 interfaces, it delivers exceptional throughput and flexibility for service providers and data centers. With dual hot-swappable DC power supplies, advanced routing protocols, and SDN/NFV-ready architecture, this router supports scalable IP/MPLS transport, seamless automation, and enhanced network resiliency.

Perfect for ISPs, telecom operators, and enterprise backbone deployments, the N540-24Z8Q2C-M ensures high availability and low latency in demanding environments.


Featured:

  • Model: Cisco NCS 540 N540‑24Z8Q2C‑M

  • Form Factor: 1RU compact, carrier-grade chassis

  • Interfaces: 24x 1GE/10GE; 8x 1GE/10GE/25GE; 2x 40GE/100GE

  • Throughput: Up to 300 Mpps (Million packets per second)

  • Power Supply: Dual hot-swappable DC power modules

  • Network Architecture: Supports IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN

  • Advanced Features: Telemetry, SDN-ready, MACsec encryption

  • Ideal For: Metro aggregation, ISP core, data center edge, mobile backhaul

  • High Availability: Redundant power and fans, carrier-grade reliability

  • Management: CLI, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, Cisco IOS XR


Bandwidth / Performance:

  • System Switching Capacity: 800 Gbps full duplex

  • Forwarding Rate: 300 million packets per second (Mpps)

  • Interface Bandwidth Breakdown:

    • 24 × 10G SFP+ ports → Up to 240 Gbps

    • 8 × 25G SFP28 ports → Up to 200 Gbps

    • 2 × 100G QSFP28 ports → Up to 200 Gbps
